description: This plot illustrates the Attack Success Rate (ASR) across various categorical triggers for an AGNews dataset under a clean-label setting with a poison rate of 10% (2.5% of total). The categorical x-axis displays eight distinct labels rotated slightly: "cf", "bb", "WNBA", "ESPN", "NHL", "FIFA", "Estadio", and "athletics". The y-axis, labeled "ASR", employs a linear scale with visible tick marks at intervals of 0.1, ranging from 0.5 to 0.9. Three solid lines represent different conditions. The "start" condition, denoted by a green line with small circular markers, begins at approximately 0.77 for "cf", drops to a minimum of 0.49 at "bb", rises sharply to 0.90 at "WNBA", dips to 0.82 at "ESPN", and then steadily increases to end at its peak of 0.93 for "athletics". The "random" condition, shown as an orange line with 'x' markers, starts at 0.66 for "cf", decreases to its lowest point of 0.52 at "bb", increases to 0.87 at "WNBA", drops to 0.72 at "ESPN", rises to a peak of 0.94 at "Estadio", and ends at 0.87 for "athletics". The "end" condition, depicted by a purple line with larger circular markers, begins at 0.75 for "cf", falls to a low of 0.57 at "bb", rises to 0.88 at "WNBA", drops to 0.75 at "ESPN", increases to 0.89 at "NHL", dips to 0.81 at "FIFA", reaches its highest overall point of 0.97 at "Estadio", and concludes at 0.83 for "athletics".
